title: Koszul reconstruction with normalized model Roos evaluations
statement: Let T, A and d be the completed coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], K an arbitrary object of D(Mod(A_T)), and M a specified K-flat representative with realization Q(M) ≅ K. Let f : Fin r → A generate the ideal of d. For every completed sequential derived limit L of the strict quotient tower of M [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit], there is an isomorphism e from its intrinsic Koszul completion [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] to L.obj. For every n, the composite of the intrinsic unit, e, L's nth product projection, and the normalized K-flat restriction and reduction comparisons equals the unit at K of the derived extension/restriction adjunction for A_T → (A/I^(n+1))_T. No completeness hypothesis is imposed on K.

proof.text: Use the Koszul-to-quotient reconstruction comparison on the given K-flat representative. Constant completed coefficient comparison identifies the coefficient rings and quotient projections. The strict Koszul augmentations preserve transitions and degree-zero inclusions, so their induced derived-limit comparison carries the intrinsic unit to the quotient unit. This is the representative version of [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction], with the coefficient comparison retained.

The strict derived-limit theorem supplies a Roos triangle for that comparison. Compare its rotation with the rotation of the specified triangle L using identity maps on both product vertices. The triangle morphism axiom and two-out-of-three give an isomorphism to L preserving its product map, hence all evaluations.

On the K-flat representative the evaluation of the quotient unit is the ordinary scalar-extension unit. The normalization in the derived scalar adjunction transports this to its derived unit at K. The universal K-flat counit and the realization are precisely the displayed restriction and inverse reduction comparisons. Thus all asserted evaluation equations hold, including for empty generator lists and zero objects.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: projective tensor products, ordinary completion tensor formulas, and formally unramified module facts; none states the derived sheaf comparison.
CategoryTheory.Functor.leftDerivedUnique: uniqueness of universal left-derived functors; useful for the comparison, but does not supply a coefficient model or a Roos comparison.

Library: AdicCoefficientDatumCompleted, IntrinsicCompletionCompleted, FiniteProjectiveTensorProducts. The old KoszulReconstruction uses a different ring/site universe interface. Mathlib Adjunction.Basic supplies naturality and Derived.LeftDerived supplies uniqueness, but no completed-sheaf model comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem completedKoszulModelRoosComparison {K : adicDatumDerived T d}
    (M : AdicDatumModel T d K) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = d.ideal)
    (L : CompletedSequentialDerivedLimit T d (adicDatumModelTower T d M)) :
    ∃ e : completedIntrinsicCompletion T d r f M.complex ≅ L.obj,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        completedIntrinsicCompletionMap T d r f M.complex M.realization ≫ e.hom ≫
          L.p ≫ Pi.π (fun a : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op a)) n ≫
          (adicDatumModelRestriction T d M n).hom ≫
          (adicDatumRestriction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).map
            (adicDatumModelReductionIso T d M n).inv =
        (adicDatumAdjunction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).unit.app K
